# Actual cap/profile data do not force large support-simplex filling

This note refutes the proposed ordinary converse

    q_i<=128|K|/279 for i=1,2,3 and F_K<=|K|
       imply |K|/|K_out|>=11/16.

The examples are exact actual convex bodies with proper cuts. They
do not assert compatible endpoint bodies A,B or genuine mixed depth
criticality. Thus they do not refute the necessary erosion deficit
proved for the actual small-A mixed configuration.

## 1. An exact triangle and its source

Use normals

    v_1=(1,0), v_2=(0,1), v_3=(-1,-1)

and take

    K=conv{(2,-1),(-1,23/16),(-1,-7/16)},
    y_0=(-1/32,1/64).

The body is invariant under the affine reflection
(x,y)->(x,-x-y), and y_0 is fixed by that reflection. Its actual
aligned outer support triangle is

    K_out={x>=-1,y>=-1,x+y<=1}=-T.

Indeed its minimum x and minimum y are -1, and its maximum x+y is
1. Each is an attained actual support value. The areas are

    k=|K|=45/16, |K_out|=9/2,
    k/|K_out|=5/8<11/16.                           (1)

The section of K at a coordinate x between -1 and 2 is centered
on y=-x/2, and has positive length. Since -1<-1/32<2 and
y_0 lies on that centerline, y_0 is in int K. Thus all three
displayed lines through y_0 are proper cuts.

Let q_i=|K intersect {v_i.x>=v_i.y_0}|. The first cap is a
triangle homothetic to K at its vertex (2,-1), with linear ratio
(2+1/32)/3=65/96. Hence

    q_1/k=4225/9216.                              (2)

For the second cap, only the upper vertex (-1,23/16) is above
y=1/64. Its two edge ratios multiply to

    q_2/k=
      (23/16-1/64)^2/[(23/16+7/16)(23/16+1)]
      =637/1440.                                 (3)

The reflection exchanges the second and third halfspaces and fixes
the body and the source, so q_3=q_2. In particular q_1>q_2=q_3.
The strict cap-fraction margins are

    128/279-q_1/k=97/285696>0,
    128/279-q_2/k=128/279-q_3/k=733/44640>0.        (4)

The sorted profile is

    F_K=q_min+q_mid+q_max/4=2q_2+q_1/4,
    F_K/k=61399/61440<1.                          (5)

Equations (1)--(5) give the exact counterexample. No sampled
inequality or numerical optimizer is used in its certificate.

## 2. Positive-length contact with all three outer facets

The same failure persists without the triangle's vertex-only
contacts on two of its outer support facets. Add two points and
take the actual convex hull

    K^+=conv(K union {(1999/1000,-1),
                       (1999/1000,-999/1000)}).

All these points remain in K_out. The two added points lie on
y=-1 and x+y=1 respectively, and the vertex (2,-1) is their
common endpoint. Thus K^+ has a positive-length exposed edge on
each of those two outer facets, as well as its original vertical
edge on x=-1. Its actual outer support triangle is still K_out.

The two disjoint added triangles, along the old two sloping edges,
each have area 9/32000, by the determinant formula for triangle
area. Consequently

    delta=|K^+\K|=9/16000,
    |K^+|/|K_out|=5001/8000<11/16.                (6)

Keep the same source and halfspaces. They remain proper because
K is contained in K^+. Each cap area increases by a number in
[0,delta]. Therefore, for each i,

    q_i(K^+)/|K^+| <= q_i(K)/k+delta/k
                         =q_i(K)/k+1/5000.

The smallest margin in (4) exceeds 1/5000:
97*5000=485000>285696. Hence every new cap fraction is still
strictly below 128/279.

The function F of three unsorted nonnegative cap areas is
coordinatewise nondecreasing, and adding at most delta to each
coordinate increases it by at most (9/4)delta. This follows either
from the sorted form or from F=sum q-(3/4)max q together with the
coordinatewise order statistics. Thus

    |K^+|-F_(K^+)
       >= k-F_K-(5/4)delta
       =123/65536-45/64000>0.                     (7)

The last sign follows, for example, from
123*64000=7872000>45*65536=2949120.
This proves every asserted condition for the actual pentagon.

## 3. Scope of the obstruction

Translation of K and y_0 together puts the source at zero if desired;
the actual support triangle translates by the same vector and the
ratio (1) is unchanged. The normals still form their positive
full-rank circuit, and no integer coordinate is involved.

The result proves that the cap fractions and the sorted ordinary
profile alone cannot supply the lower support filling needed to
contradict the mixed erosion bound theta<11/16. Even positive-length
contacts on all outer facets do not repair that implication.

The actual K-source data above do not include common mixed budgets
Q=q_i+U_i, the actual endpoint support erosion, or the full critical
section-moment equalities of compatible A,B. Those are additional
conditions, and none is silently supplied by this ordinary example.
